description.en: A todo list with one AI entry that turns free text into tasks, changes the list on request and plans the day; a task can be handed to the AI to do.
description.zh: 一个 AI 入口的待办清单：随手写的一段话拆成带日期、优先级和标签的任务，一句话就能改清单或排今天的顺序；任务可以交给 AI 执行。

online.en: Reading free text and running tasks with AI need a model
online.zh: AI 解析和执行需要模型
